author: TylerdotMichael
body:
Hey everyone!

 So I am in this design class and I need some information for some research. If you are between the ages of 8 to 13 can you please fill out this survey?

 http://smith-m.com/demographic-survey/

I would be greatly appreciative if you could! And even better, if you are able to share it with your friends, cousins, or siblings that would be great! I need a good amount of people to fill this out so I can take the information and design a beverage from it :P

It's completely anonymous. Thanks everyone!!
